Rio Tinto (2022). Rio Tinto Pacific Operations Hydrogen Program: Hydrogen Calcination Feasibility Study Report (ARENA Project 2020/ARP027), submitted 15 Nov 2022. Prepared by Sreeraj Balachandran, Manager Climate Change, Rio Tinto Aluminium Ltd. Australian Renewable Energy Agency knowledge bank. https://arena.gov.au/knowledge-bank/rio-tinto-hydrogen-feasibility-study-report

Locators are printed page numbers, which equal PDF page numbers (29 pages; footer "(c) 2022 Rio Tinto N"). The PDF is a Word "print to PDF" without a usable text layer (glyph IDs without unicode mapping), so text was read by OCR (tesseract, 200 dpi) and checked against rendered pages; Table 2 (test conditions) and the Table 3 stream columns were garbled and only the figures quoted in the surrounding text were used. The public report contains NO cost data (no capex, opex or indicative costs) and no energy balance for the retrofitted calciner beyond the equal-energy hydrogen sizing; the numbers loaded are the existing calciner natural gas use (derived from the printed 5.65 t/h at 155 t/h hydrate and LHV), the hydrogen design basis for the pilot, temperatures, the 50% net decarbonisation figure and the pilot compression/storage sizing. Energy intensities are per t of hydrate feed (alumina yield per t hydrate is not printed; stoichiometry from the printed reaction 2Al2O3.3H2O -> 2Al2O3 + 3H2O is about 0.65 t alumina/t hydrate if the coordinator needs per t alumina). Digester steam options are not quantified; only the steam capture/MVR concept is described.
Table 1 flame temperatures are cited in the text as "Table 7"; OCR of Tables 2-3 unreliable. The "2,300 tpd" capacity does not state whether it is hydrate or alumina.
